data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2034 is set to be the biggest celebration on the Costa del Sol — and there's no better way to join the party than from the deck of a private yacht. Departing from the iconic Puerto Banús, our fleet offers everything from a speedy 5-person speedboat to a 29-metre Ferretti for 12 guests. With free drinks, snacks, and a licensed skipper included, you can focus on the fun. Here's how to plan your Marbella Pride 2034 yacht charter celebration.

Why charter a yacht for Marbella Pride 2034?

Marbella Pride draws thousands to the Golden Mile, but the real VIP experience is on the water. A private yacht gives you front-row views of the parade from the marina, a cool escape from the June heat, and total privacy for your group. You can swim in calm coves like Cala del Faro, dance to your own playlist, and watch the sunset over La Concha mountain. It's the ultimate Pride party setting.

Our fleet for Pride 2034

We have boats for every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Here's a quick overview:

  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) — intimate and agile, great for couples
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) — Tier A, from €749/2h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) — Tier A, same price
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) — sporty and stylish
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — from €4,719/4h, includes jet ski
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) — luxury flybridge, perfect for Pride
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) — spacious deck for dancing

See all options on our [fleet page](/).

Pricing: Tier A boats and the Mangusta 80

For a cost-effective Pride charter, our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. This includes the skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. For a larger group, the Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, and you get a jet ski included for free. All other boats are priced on request — just message us on WhatsApp for a custom quote.

What's included on every charter

Every booking comes with a licensed skipper who knows the coast, fuel for the day, and a cooler full of water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light snacks are provided, and all safety equipment and insurance are covered. The price you see is the price you pay — no surprises. Just bring your swimsuit, sunscreen, and Pride spirit.

Best routes for a Pride celebration at sea

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise east past the Marbella Marina and the Golden Mile, or head west to the quieter coves near Estepona. Popular stops include:

  • Cala del Faro — a rocky cove with crystal water, great for snorkelling
  • Cala Cortés — sandy beach only reachable by boat
  • Cabopino — a nature reserve with a laid-back beach bar
  • Estepona — charming old town and a long promenade

Your skipper can tailor the route to your group's wishes. Most charters include time to swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the views of La Concha mountain.

How to book your Pride yacht charter

Booking is simple. Visit our [homepage](/), choose your boat, and contact us via WhatsApp or the online form. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance for Pride week — June is high season and boats fill quickly. You can also call or email us for personal advice. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link.

Frequently asked questions

What boats are available for Marbella Pride 2034?

We offer a wide range: from a Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) for an intimate trip, to a Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) for a larger party. All depart from Puerto Banús. See our full fleet on the [homepage](/).

How much does a yacht charter cost for Pride 2034?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours (jet ski included). Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Can we bring our own decorations or music?

Yes, you are welcome to bring rainbow flags, banners, or a Bluetooth speaker. Just check with the skipper beforehand. Most boats have a sound system — the Mangusta 80 has a premium setup.

Where can we sail during the Pride charter?

Popular routes include cruising along the Golden Mile, anchoring at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, or heading to Cabopino. You can also sail south towards Estepona. The skipper will tailor the trip.

Is the boat private just for our group?

Absolutely. Every charter is private — only your group and the skipper. No sharing with strangers. Perfect for a Pride celebration with friends or family.

How do I book a yacht for Marbella Pride 2034?

Contact us via WhatsApp (link on our site) or use the booking form. We recommend booking early — Pride week is popular. You can also call or email us directly.

What happens if the weather is bad?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we reschedule or offer a full refund. June in Marbella is generally sunny with calm seas.
